Strategy: Half-gap pairing preference. Score each bin by how close its post-placement residual is to half the current item size, preferring a leftover gap that could hold a half-size item. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest fit leaves a residual far from half the item while a looser bin leaves a gap near it. It may help by creating reusable half-size gaps, but may fail if future items are not about half the current size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - item - item / 2) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Half-gap pairing preference: post-placement residual closest to item/2 wins.
